_comment: Copy this file to brand.config.json and edit. Or, easier: open Claude Code and the skill walks you through the setup interview, writing this file for you. After editing by hand, run `python3 content-bank/almanac/build.py` to regenerate theme.css with your palette.
topic_domain: What this account posts about, in one sentence. Used for topic ideation. Example: 'productivity-system how-tos for indie founders'.
voice_rules: Standard English grammar. First letter of every sentence is capital. No em dashes — use commas, periods, or rewrite. No emojis. Plain prose, not marketing copy.
content_rules: All factual claims need a citable source. Statistics need a year + source.
